text:
Lena Ortiz: quick note from hallway testing — the compact relevance toolbar (above vectors table) is packed, and users missed the download action because its an icon-only button with low hover contrast. also the toolbar hint 'Selected: 3' isn't read out by screen readers.
Kai Morgan: agree, saw same in session 12. toolbar has: checkbox, selection count, rerank, compact-sort, icon-only download, kebab. visually dense.
A11y QA: issues observed: 1) icon-only download uses aria-label='export' which is ambiguous; 2) selection count is a plain <span> with no aria-live; SRs don't announce selection changes; 3) focus order sometimes skips the hint when using keyboard.
Lena Ortiz: design ask: can we try compressing icons but making download a small pill with text at >= AA contrast on hover? keeps density but improves discoverability. example label: "Download (CSV)".
Samir Patel: implementation constraints: adding visible text will push other controls. alternative: keep icon-only but add an always-present compact label in the toolbar: "Download (D)" next to the icons and make the icon a purely decorative affordance. keyboard users would still tab to the actual button.
A11y QA: both approaches OK if we ensure these: proper aria-label ("Download selected vectors as CSV"), selection count as aria-live polite ("3 selected"), and use role="toolbar" on the container so SRs expose grouping. also ensure the download action is reachable as the Nth tabbable item in an expected order.
Kai Morgan: microcopy: toolbar hint should be "3 selected" rather than "Selected: 3" so its succinct and reads naturally in an aria-live region. also put shortcut hint as "Download (D)".
Lena Ortiz: what about keyboard shortcut scoping? global D would conflict. scoped to table when table has focus is safest. show a tiny persistent hint (sr-only + visual) when table focused: "Shortcuts: Download (D)".
Samir Patel: note on contrast: current hover state for icon is 1.9:1. must raise to >=3:1 for icons on background per compact UI guidance. will update tokens and request a quick audit from design tokens team.
A11y QA: voiceover notes: when user changes selection, announce "3 selected" only once. avoid double announcements from both the click handler and aria-live if we also update a counter. debounce updates for 300ms.
Lena Ortiz: CSV UX nit — include a header row mapping to visible column names ("Relevance score" not "score"). and filename pattern: "vectors-<space>-<date>.csv". also include a tiny modal confirmation for large exports (over 1k rows) with accessible progress.
Kai Morgan: large export performance: show streaming download with progress bar and an aria-live toast: "Preparing download..." -> "Download ready". keep focus in table; don't shift to the toast.
Samir Patel: engineering checklist: 1) update aria-label and role=toolbar; 2) add aria-live polite for selection counter and debounce; 3) implement scoped shortcut D with announcement and tooltip; 4) raise hover contrast to 3:1; 5) CSV filename pattern and header mapping; 6) confirmation modal for >1000 rows with accessible progress.
A11y QA: I'll add NVDA/VoiceOver/TalkBack test steps to the issue including keyboard-only flow, shortcut behavior, aria-live timing, and hover contrast verification.
DesignBot: Created issue #5233: "Compact relevance toolbar: download discoverability, aria-live selection, shortcut (D), contrast" and assigned to Samir Patel. :white_check_mark:
Lena Ortiz: i'll upload 3 compact toolbar mocks (icon-only + hint, pill label, and kebab-only mobile) and include mobile fallback where download lives in kebab. dropping by EOD. thanks! :sparkles:
